{"E": 8.5, "P": 7.4, "L": 9.5, "E_Expl": "The speaker establishes credibility through courtesy and acknowledgment of the debate setting, while conveying the importance of discussing the country's future.", "P_Expl": "The speaker connects emotionally with the audience by addressing concerns related to jobs, housing, retirement savings, and education.", "L_Expl": "The speaker uses a logical structure to present a series of proposals regarding the financial rescue, oversight, and direct support for homeowners, as well as critique of existing policies."}
